name: AI-Powered B2B Lead Generation
headline: AI-Powered B2B Lead Generation - Leads-db
short_description: Leads-db is an AI-driven B2B lead generation platform designed to streamline the process of identifying and acquiring potential business clients. With its powerful algorithms, it enhances sales and marketing efforts by providing high-quality leads tailored to your business needs.
author: IsaacBell

sections.overview:
LeadsDB is a lead generation system designed for sales teams seeking qualified B2B prospects. The platform performs daily ingestions of company data and newly registered domains (NRDs), then identifies and ranks candidate leads based on your criteria. Leads can be retrieved through a REST API, enabling direct integration into your existing workflows. The system enriches company data using Abstract API and supports subscriber preferences by email, country, and industry. LeadsDB currently supports API-based lead retrieval and email updates, with planned integrations for HubSpot and Salesforce.
Identifying high-potential leads for outreach
Automating lead qualification processes
Integrating with CRM systems for streamlined workflows
Enhancing marketing campaigns with targeted lead lists
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install IsaacBell/leads-db`
`git clone https://github.com/IsaacBell/leads-db`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a prioritized list of 10 high-quality B2B leads for [COMPANY_NAME] targeting [TARGET_INDUSTRY] in [TARGET_REGION]. For each lead, include: company name, job title of the decision-maker, LinkedIn profile URL, a personalized outreach message tailored to their role, and a suggested next step with timeline. Use [COMPANY_CRITERIA] to filter leads (e.g., revenue size, tech stack, funding stage). Export the list in a CSV format with headers: Company, Decision-Maker, Title, LinkedIn, Outreach Message, Next Step, Timeline.
```
